biotools.summary: Metagenomics-Toolkit is a scalable workflow that automates the analysis of short and long metagenomic reads from Illumina and Oxford Nanopore Technology devices. It provides standard features and unique capabilities like plasmid identification and genome-scale metabolic modeling, optimized for efficient cloud-based cluster execution.
